title: France: component-order robustness for ADDR_CANON_FR
headline: Component order is NOT a defect: normalize_address is provably order-independent for state resolution, confirmed by executing the real normalize.py. The work order's main premise is refuted. The real France risk is bis/ter handled asymmetrically in the direction that KEEPS THE NOISE: ter is deleted by ADDR_GENERIC while bis survives into blocking keys and the IDF table (5.86x asymmetry). Separately, fused number+suffix forms (5bis, 12b) are never split, and the house number is dropped from blocking keys.

verdict.component_order_defect: REFUTED - no defect, order-independent by construction

component_order.claim_tested: French addresses put the region in inconsistent positions; does any code path assume a fixed order?
component_order.verdict: NO fixed-order assumption in the state path
component_order.evidence: normalize.py:322 splits on ',' into comps; :328-335 loops over EVERY component testing 'if ck in smap' with no positional index (no comps[0], no comps[-1])
component_order.method: executed the real unmodified _upstream/src/normalize.py with polars stubbed

city_last_order_sensitivity.verdict: GENUINE but pre-existing and not France-caused
city_last_order_sensitivity.location: normalize.py:351-352 (append in encounter order) + features.py:90 (x.split('|')[-1] = LAST)

executed_examples.note: recognised region is continue'd at :335, never enters city_comps, so single-city case is stable

city_last_order_sensitivity.population_size: GAP - num_components per row not collected

bis_ter_asymmetry.addr_canon_fr_line: normalize.py:211 maps bis->bis, b->bis, ter->ter, t->ter (both handled)
bis_ter_asymmetry.defect: keys.py:14-19 ADDR_GENERIC contains 'ter' (inherited from US terrace sense, normalize.py:166) but NOT 'bis', so the two semantically identical French suffixes get opposite treatment
bis_ter_asymmetry.consequence: ~0.58% of every French address token stream is a suffix with zero location information, yet it gets a full IDF entry and can generate kind-2 address blocking keys (keys.py:63-69); attached to a house number it also creates a spurious number x word pair

fused_number_suffix.verdict: CONFIRMED defect - signal loss, not just noise
fused_number_suffix.root_cause: normalize.py:342 splits on _non_alnum = [^a-z0-9]+ (:269); digits and letters are both alphanumeric so '5bis' is never split
fused_number_suffix.canon_lookup_fails: ADDR_CANON_FR.get('5bis') is None; ADDR_CANON_FR.get('12b') is None
fused_number_suffix.damage_mechanism: keys.py:41 derives blocking nums from the TOKEN STRING by ^\d+$, not from normalize_address's nums field, so the fused form keeps its number for features (features.py:99 qm1/sm1 read anums) but loses it from the blocking keys

leet.note: the name path would actively corrupt 5bis into sbis (digit 5 -> s)
